en.headline: Marine Department opens applications for Guangdong yachts heading south
en.dek: Owners or captains of Guangdong-registered yachts can now apply up to 30 days before arrival, with the first southbound trips set for Friday.
body: The Marine Department said applications for the Guangdong Yachts Heading South scheme opened on Wednesday, allowing owners or captains of Guangdong-registered yachts to handle cross-border procedures as early as 30 days before arrival in Hong Kong.

Applicants must complete online declarations through the Hong Kong system at least 30 hours before arrival and through the mainland system at least four hours before leaving mainland waters. The department has set up a real-time monitoring system for yacht movements and an electronic business system for one-stop services.

The first southbound voyages are scheduled for Friday. Over recent months the government has provided training and assessments for mainland captains on Hong Kong waters, while designated berths have been prepared in several locations including Tai Tam Bay, Stanley Bay and Cheung Sha.

zh.headline: 海事處即日起接受「粵艇南下」申請 最早可提前30日辦手續
zh.dek: 廣東籍遊艇船東或船長可於到港前30日辦理跨境手續，首航定於星期五。
body: 海事處宣布，「粵艇南下」計劃即日起接受申請。廣東籍遊艇如計劃南下香港，船東或船長最早可於到港前30日辦理跨境手續。
申請人須於抵港前最遲30小時完成香港網上申報，以及離開內地水域前4小時完成內地申報。海事處已建立實時遊艇動態監察系統及電子業務系統，方便停泊及提供一站式服務。
首航定於星期五。過去數月當局已為內地船長提供香港水域知識訓練及考核，並在大潭灣、赤柱灣、企嶺下海等地預留指定泊位。
